title: Apparel Return Window
text: Apparel items can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Apparel Return Window
text: The item must be unused, unwashed, and have its original tags and packaging.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Footwear can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Shoes should be unused and returned with their original packaging and tags.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: The product should include its original accessories, packaging, and applicable warranty materials.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: The product must be unused and returned in suitable original packaging.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For eligible cash-on-delivery returns, the refund is processed after the returned product passes the required checks.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: Refund timing can depend on the selected refund method.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For eligible prepaid orders, refunds are initiated after the returned product passes the required checks.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: The amount is normally returned to the original payment method.

title: Delivery SLA
text: Expected delivery dates depend on the destination, seller location, product availability, and logistics conditions.

title: Delivery SLA
text: The delivery estimate shown for the order is the primary reference.

title: Delivery Delay
text: A delivery may be delayed because of weather, logistics disruptions, high order volumes, or other operational conditions.

title: Delivery Delay
text: Customers should use the latest tracking information for the current status.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available when the item and order qualify for return pickup.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Pickup availability can depend on the product, location, and logistics serviceability.

title: Return Condition
text: Returned products should be in an acceptable condition according to the applicable return policy.

title: Return Condition
text: Missing accessories, damage, or signs of use may affect return eligibility.

title: Return Pickup Attempt
text: If a reverse pickup attempt cannot be completed, another pickup attempt may be scheduled when the service is available.

title: Return Pickup Attempt
text: Customers should keep the package ready for collection.

title: Non-Returnable Products
text: Some products may not be eligible for return because of their category or specific product conditions.

title: Non-Returnable Products
text: The product page and order information should be checked for the applicable return eligibility.

title: Exchange Eligibility
text: Exchange availability depends on the product and the applicable seller policy.

title: Exchange Eligibility
text: An exchange may require the returned product to satisfy the required condition checks.

title: Order Cancellation
text: Order cancellation is possible only while the order is in an eligible stage of processing.

title: Order Cancellation
text: Once an order has progressed beyond the cancellation stage, the customer may need to use the applicable return process.
